1. Executive Summary
The City Development Authority (CDA) invites qualified vendors to submit proposals for the implementation
of a Smart City Analytics Platform.
The objective of this project is to establish a centralized smart city platform capable of collecting,
processing, analyzing, and visualizing city-wide operational data from multiple sources, including
transportation systems, IoT devices, environmental sensors, and public services.
The platform shall provide real-time insights, predictive analytics, and executive dashboards to support
data-driven urban planning and operational excellence.
2. Background
As urban populations continue to grow, city authorities face increasing challenges related to infrastructure
management, transportation efficiency, environmental sustainability, and public service delivery.
Current challenges include:
Traffic congestion
•

Limited operational visibility
Fragmented city data
Resource allocation inefficiencies
Environmental monitoring challenges
The Authority seeks a centralized platform that enables proactive decision-making and supports future
smart city initiatives.

Improve sustainability initiatives.
Technology Objectives

Provide advanced analytics.
Enable real-time monitoring.
Deliver executive dashboards.
